heroAnswer: Ohio's humid continental climate makes mold a statewide, year-round issue — roughly 40 inches of annual rainfall, muggy summers, and freeze-thaw winters. Older housing stock plus Great Miami River floodplain moisture create persistent risk, from ice-dam attic mold in winter to basement and crawl-space mold in humid summer months. We serve Ohio with free inspections, transparent pricing, and photo-documented work.

moldLawNote: Ohio has no statewide mold assessor or remediator licensing requirement (unlike Florida, Texas, and New York, which do license mold professionals). Contractors should follow EPA and IICRC S520 remediation guidelines; homeowners should verify any contractor's general credentials and insurance.
moldStory: Ohio's humid continental climate — roughly 40 inches of annual rainfall, muggy summers, and freeze-thaw winters — makes mold a statewide, year-round issue. The Miami Valley's older housing stock (much of it pre-1980) plus Great Miami River floodplain moisture create persistent moisture-intrusion risk, from ice-dam attic mold in winter to basement and crawl-space mold in the humid summer months.
